fact_summary: Techteryx Ltd, parent of a stablecoin issuer, alleges that USD 456 million in reserves backing its stablecoin were fraudulently misappropriated and diverted through Aria DMCC accounts in Dubai. Hong Kong proceedings (Action 161/2023) are the primary forum; Justice Black KC of the DIFC Digital Economy Court issued a worldwide freezing order in October 2025. Aria DMCC's compliance under that order revealed at least USD 46 million had flowed onward to accounts at the IG Group of trading platforms. After voluntary disclosure was refused on confidentiality grounds, Techteryx applied to the DEC for a Norwich Pharmacal + Bankers Trust order against the four IG respondents. IG did not oppose the substance and requested only a 21-day compliance window (vs the original 14-day proposal). Black KC granted the order in full as modified — the first DEC trace and the first to express a third-party-jurisdiction gate over a digital-asset dispute.
